problem_description: Evaluate the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/8 of x·sin(2x) with respect to x.

prerequisites.reason: The integrand is a product of x and sin(2x); integration by parts is the standard technique for such products.
After finding the antiderivative, the limits 0 and π/8 must be substituted.
Knowledge of how to integrate sin(2x) and related trigonometric functions is needed.

givens.known_facts: Lower limit of integration is 0; upper limit is π/8.
givens.explanation: These limits define the definite integral to be evaluated.
Identifies the function to be integrated.
